issues.on_page: Noxious Weed listed under Public Works (Total Public Works 132,893; p4 General Fund Public Works 132,893)
issues.issue: Noxious Weed lines (88,273 / 5,839 / 9,216) are categorized natural resources/conservation per the category list, but the report places them under Public Works, so the General Fund detail by function will not tie to the p4 Public Works column (detail streets/highways 29,565 vs 132,893). Defensible either way.

issues.on_page: Road/Bridge budget schedule Taxes 8,193; p4 Road/Bridge column Taxes '-', Charges for services 36,046 (= 8,193 + 27,854 - 1)
issues.issue: The governmental funds statement reports no taxes in the Road/Bridge Fund; this 8,193 appears to be counted there as charges for services. Kept as printed on the budget schedule, which is acceptable, but the label and category may mislead.

Standalone capital outlay lines in category capital outlay are not relabelled 'Capital Outlay: <function>' (also detail[138] LEC 1,911,892 p15, detail[142] ARPA 1,240,940 p16, detail[152] nonmajor 600,000 p22). The user rule (2026-10-28) covers these; user_rules.py should apply it.

issues.extracted: nonmajor funds recorded from combining schedule Total column (p22), function-level only
issues.on_page: Nonmajor budgetary comparison schedule pp17-20 prints per-fund object lines (e.g. Visitors Promotion and Improvement: Personnel services 68,538, Operating expenses 178,829...; Health Fund Personnel services 512,864)
issues.issue: The budget schedule is more detailed by object than the combining Total column. Choosing the combining schedule avoids the transfers mixed into the budget schedule's receipts/disbursements (34,028 in / 122,807 out) and ties to p4, so the choice is defensible, but some object detail is not captured.
